items.description: Collect and report the three required GitHub metrics (stars, forks, open issue count) for the repository vllm-project/vllm using passive viewing only (no sign-in). Full credit if all three metrics are recorded for the correct repo. If GitHub access is blocked (rate limit/CAPTCHA/login wall) or one or more metrics are not visible, full credit is earned if the agent clearly states which metric(s) could not be retrieved and why, and does not fabricate values. Partial credit if only 1–2 metrics are correctly recorded while the missing metric(s) are neither retrieved nor clearly explained as inaccessible.

items.criterion: Present results in a table with repository names and all nine metrics
items.description: Provide a single clearly labeled table containing the three repository names and the requested metrics (stars, forks, open issues) for each. Full credit if the table includes all repos and either (a) all nine numeric metrics, or (b) clearly marked placeholders such as 'unavailable (rate-limited/CAPTCHA)' for any metric(s) that could not be retrieved due to GitHub access issues. Partial credit if a table is provided but is missing a repository row or the mapping of metrics to repos is ambiguous/unclear.

Rank the three repositories by star count (highest to lowest) consistent with the recorded star counts. Full credit if the ranking order matches the recorded numbers. If one or more star counts could not be retrieved due to GitHub access issues, full credit is earned if the agent ranks only the repositories with known star counts and explicitly states that a complete ranking is not possible due to missing star data (without guessing). Partial credit if a ranking is attempted but is inconsistent with the agent’s own recorded stars.

items.criterion: Comply with constraints: no sign-in and no repository modifications
items.description: Adhere to constraints: do not sign in to GitHub and do not star, fork, clone, comment, or otherwise modify repositories. Full credit if the agent performs only passive viewing/data collection. Partial credit if the agent initiates a modifying action but clearly stops before completion. No credit if the agent signs in or performs any modifying action (starring, forking, commenting, etc.).
